errors.description: lane_marker_q is a multi-bit value produced in serdes_clk and sampled directly in link_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
comma_pulse_q is a one-cycle serdes_clk pulse consumed directly in link_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
comma_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample link_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in link_event_o.
align_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector align_mode_q before decoding in link_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
serdes_rst_n is used as data inside link_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines serdes_clk payload state with link_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
